description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 9

The red mage can expend 1 point from his arcane pool as an immediate action after hitting a target with a weapon attack, granting him a premonition of his enemy's intentions. The red mage gains a bonus to his AC and on Reflex saves equal to his Charisma modifier (minimum 0) against attacks by that opponent until the beginning of his next turn.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Arcana)
